description: For \(i\le x\), the doubling machine at input \(x\) and time \(i\) has configuration \(\langle x-i,2i\rangle\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.MachinesAndComputationHistories.doubling_run (x i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.run
      Lemmatheca.Entry.MachinesAndComputationHistories.doublingMachine x i =
    Nat.pair (x - i) (2 * i)
